description: A backrooms/SCP-inspired extraction shooter on @red-cup-engineering/abrash: OG-Wolfenstein-grade raycast graphics, Quake-grade momentum physics (a BNSF-owned kernel composing abrash's real collision.move -- bunnyhop speed gain, rocket-jump verticality, both numerically tested) over seeded backrooms-liminal levels whose contested (⊤) walls -- abrash's own held-contradiction mechanic -- shiver as the dread signal. Four anomalies, each a learnable, tested behavior contract (watched vs unwatched, sound through walls, territory, an unconditional toll). Loot is banked only on an explicit extraction at a beacon; unbanked loot is simply never counted on death -- what you carry is what you can lose.
statusNote: Live-playtested (real BFS+optimal-strafe controller driving the actual deployed build, not a mock): movement numbers are real and measured -- ground max 7 u/s, bunnyhop reaches >2x ground max within 7 hop cycles, rocket-jump apex clears 1.4x a normal jump's height while a normal jump alone does not. All four anomalies are live and distinct (Unwitnessed: watched vs unwatched; Hum: sound-through-walls hunt-and-juke; Warden: territorial retreat-before-aggro dread; Toll: an unconditional pursuit tied to one warded high-value item, its guardian's spawn distance tuned 2026-08-20 after a playtest found it spawning on top of its own loot with zero counterplay). Extraction economy confirmed live: banked loot survives death, unbanked loot is simply forfeited, a real extraction was driven end to end. Known thinness, stated plainly: content volume is still small (one authored encounter density per tier, not a deep library of variety) and there is no audio yet -- The Hum's "loudness" is a pure game-logic signal today, not a real sound layer.
